title: Characterization of Pyrotechnic Mixtures using High Resolution Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and X-Ray Fluorescence
content: Mixtures of fuel and oxidizer powders for pyrotechnics are commonly used in a variety of applications. Distributions of each constituent in such pyrotechnic mixtures are known to influence their performance characteristics. As such, there is a need for analysis methods that can assess distributions of each constituent on both a local and global scale. A variety of methods to quantify composition exist, but many of these are labor and material intensive. Similarly, there are several putative methods for measuring particle size distributions in particulate materials; however, methods for determining the spatial distribution of the individual constituents in a dense, consolidated mixture are less well-established. Due to the diffusion limited nature of reactions in pyrotechnic mixtures, developing quantitative or semi-quantitative methods for determining local spatial distributions are of particular interest. We are currently developing analysis methods that address these issues.
